profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Target

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Guest Experience Management is responsible for helping guests find what they want when they want it. We power Target’s web and mobile app site taxonomy and page attribution. 

Back-End Skills: Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Spring & Spring Webflux, GraphQL, MongoDb, Postgres, MySQL, ElasticSearch, Gradle, Docker, Spock, JUnit, Jira, Git

Front-End Skills: JavaScript, React, anode, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer - Digital Post Purchase
positions.description:
The Digital Post Purchase team is responsible for powering all post-purchase related activities that allow guests and customer service agents to modify, track or cancel an order (order history, returns/refunds, shipment tracking, store drive-up, payment changes, etc.).

Skills: Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Spring, Gradle, JUnit, Postgres, JavaScript, React, DOMO, Jira, Git

positions.title: Business Development Consultant
positions.description: Act as a third party consultant to help develop sales, marketing workflow strategies and tools for production agencies.

positions.title: Managing Partner, Head of Business Development
positions.description:
-Set BD strategic agenda for the Central territory including setting goals and objectives with corporate targets. 
-Identified new markets and potential growth opportunities, including the growth of new clients and members. 
-Prospected and developed C-level relationships with a focus on Fortune 500 - 1000 clients. 
-Set performance goals, tracked performance and held team accountable for results.

Gympass is a discovery platform that empowers companies to engage their workforce in physical activity by providing access to the largest global network of workout facilities. With a single monthly membership, companies can help employees find an activity they'll love among more than 40,000 facilities and 800 activities across the U.S., Europe, and Latin America.

positions.title: Executive Director of Business Development
positions.description:
-Developed strategic direction of B2B business model and products.
-Identified new markets and potential growth opportunities including the growth of new clients with a focus on digital publishers and agencies.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
-Residential sales marketing platform.
-Managed relationships with real estate developers, architects, management companies and brokers.

positions.title: GM, Games.com & Cambio
positions.description:
-Managed and oversaw group P&L.
-Responsible for product, editorial/content, operations and strategic partnerships.
-Assisted in the sale and execution of national ad campaigns targeting specific demographics and regions.

positions.title: Head of Business Strategy and Operations - AOL Entertainment
positions.description:
-Managed and streamlined integration of unified operations, systems and procedures across 7 business lines.
-Assisted in m&a and divestures of products within the AOL Entertainment scope.
-Integrated and launched e-commerce (micro-transactions) across properties.
-Oversaw all software licensing agreements, contract negotiations and renewals (EA, Zynga, Masque, etc.)

positions.title: Senior Manager, Strategy and Strategic Partnerships - Games.com
positions.description: -Established and oversaw relationships of national ad sales, software licensing, content and e-commerce partnerships.

honors.title: Webby Award - Games Honoree
honors.issuer: Issued by International Academy of Digital Arts and Sciences · Jan 2013
